boot_latency.unpatched_baseline_note: 4-minute unskippable intro cinematic & intro world flyover
boot_latency.harness_bypassed_note: Direct to main menu via LetMePlay CinematicsPatch + IPC launch flags

remediated_mods_breakdown.root_cause: ZDO sector partitioning refactored from Vector2i to Vector2s in ZDOMan.FindSectorObjects. RPC_ZDOData IL local variable shifted: V_12 is ZDO, V_13 is Boolean.
remediated_mods_breakdown.remediation: Updated sector type to Vector2s; rewritten transpiler index targeting V_12.

remediated_mods_breakdown.root_cause: SEMan.AddStatusEffect signature added 5th parameter: Int16 variant = 0.
remediated_mods_breakdown.remediation: Updated prefix/postfix Harmony patch signatures to include Int16 variant.

remediated_mods_breakdown.root_cause: PieceTable.SetCategory added overload accepting PieceCategory enum alongside int.
remediated_mods_breakdown.remediation: Specified exact argument types in AccessTools.Method reflection calls.

remediated_mods_breakdown.root_cause: Roslyn lowered compiler-generated closure lambda <Method>b__0 to local function <Method>g__...|0.
remediated_mods_breakdown.remediation: Re-routed Cecil/Harmony method target to the lowered local function token.

remediated_mods_breakdown.root_cause: GameCamera.UpdateMouseCapture keycode evaluation order reversed (F1 before LeftControl).
remediated_mods_breakdown.remediation: Updated IL pattern matcher sequence to reflect new evaluation order.

remediated_mods_breakdown.root_cause: InventoryGui.Show added 2nd parameter: int activeGroup = 1. Character.TakeInput changed stack layout.
remediated_mods_breakdown.remediation: Patched InventoryGui.Show overload and aligned IL evaluation stack.

remediated_mods_breakdown.root_cause: InventoryGui.UpdateContainer refactored inline button checks into separate UseButtonHeld() method.
remediated_mods_breakdown.remediation: Changed patch target from inline loop to Postfix on UseButtonHeld().

remediated_mods_breakdown.root_cause: PlatformManager.DistributionPlatform is uninitialized during early plugin Awake().
remediated_mods_breakdown.remediation: Added null check and safe fallback to Utils.persistantDataPath.

remediated_mods_breakdown.root_cause: Accessing FileHelpers.CloudStorageSupported before Steam subsystem initialization.
remediated_mods_breakdown.remediation: Guarded cloud storage calls behind initialization check.

remediated_mods_breakdown.root_cause: Valheim 1.0 added mandatory 4-minute intro cinematic and flyover.
remediated_mods_breakdown.remediation: Implemented CinematicsPatch to immediately short-circuit FejdStartup into the main menu.

architectural_shifts.name: Sector Partitioning Modernization
architectural_shifts.new_signature: Vector2s FindSectorObjects(Vector2s sector, int distance, SimulationDistance simDist)
architectural_shifts.impact: Breaks all spatial coordinate mods, map tracking, and network entity synchronization.

architectural_shifts.name: Status Effect Variant Parameter Expansion
architectural_shifts.old_signature: StatusEffect AddStatusEffect(int nameHash, bool resetTime, int itemLevel, float skillLevel)
architectural_shifts.new_signature: StatusEffect AddStatusEffect(int nameHash, bool resetTime, int itemLevel, float skillLevel, Int16 variant)
architectural_shifts.impact: Breaks all skill, buff, debuff, and equipment effect patches via MissingMethodException.

architectural_shifts.name: Build Table Strong Typing & Overloading
architectural_shifts.new_signature: void SetCategory(int index) AND void SetCategory(PieceCategory category)
architectural_shifts.impact: Reflection calls using AccessTools.Method(typeof(PieceTable), "SetCategory") crash with AmbiguousMatchException.

architectural_shifts.name: Roslyn 4.x Compiler Closure Lowering
architectural_shifts.old_pattern: Compiler generates nested class `<>c__DisplayClass` with lambda `<MethodName>b__0`
architectural_shifts.impact: Direct IL/Harmony hooks targeting compiler-generated delegate methods fail silently or crash on assembly load.

architectural_shifts.name: GUI Container Interaction Refactor
architectural_shifts.old_pattern: Inline keycode/axis polling inside UpdateContainer() loop
architectural_shifts.new_pattern: Encapsulated into UseButtonHeld() helper method; Show() takes int activeGroup
architectural_shifts.impact: Transpilers scanning for inline Input.GetKey opcodes fail to locate insertion anchors.

architectural_shifts.name: Platform Distribution Subsystem Deferral
architectural_shifts.old_behavior: PlatformManager.DistributionPlatform initialized before first BepInEx Awake() cycle
architectural_shifts.impact: Plugins calling FileHelpers.CloudStorageSupported or Steam APIs in early Awake() throw NullReferenceException.
